mechanism: Lansoprazole inhibits CYP3A4, reducing eplerenone metabolism and increasing eplerenone plasma concentrations, which may elevate potassium and blood pressure.
action: Monitor potassium levels and blood pressure when lansoprazole is initiated or discontinued; consider alternative proton pump inhibitor with less CYP3A4 inhibition (e.g., pantoprazole) or dose adjustment of eplerenone.
